{{Short description|Football tournament}}
The '''2022 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages''' were played from 8 February to 17 March 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2022_16_ago_2021.pdf|title=Calendario 2022: CONMEBOL Libertadores, CONMEBOL Sudamericana y la CONMEBOL Recopa|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=16 August 2021|language=es}}</ref> A total of 19 teams competed in the qualifying stages to decide four of the 32 places in the [[2022 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]] of the [[2022 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/documentos/manual-de-clubes-reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2022/|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2022|date=22 December 2021 |publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the qualifying stages was held on 20 December 2021, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Qualifying stages draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/pautas-para-los-sorteos-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022|title=Pautas para los sorteos de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 December 2021|language=es}}</ref><ref name="fixture 1S-2S">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/la-apasionante-conmebol-libertadores-conoce-sus-primeros-duelos|title=La apasionante CONMEBOL Libertadores conoce sus primeros duelos|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=20 December 2021|language=es}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 16 December 2021 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2022-es|title=Ranking de clubes CONMEBOL 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores|language=es|date=17 December 2021|access-date=17 December 2021}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2012–2021.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2011 and 2002–2011 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the first stage, the six teams were drawn into three ties (E1–E3), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg.<ref name="Draw methodology">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/pautas_del_sorteo_fase_preliminar_conmebol_libertadores_2022.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2022 PAUTAS DEL SORTEO FASE PRELIMINAR|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=17 December 2021|language=es}}</ref>

For the second stage, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (C1–C8), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association cannot be drawn into the same tie, excluding the three winners of the first stage, which will be seeded in Pot 2 and whose identity will not be known at the time of the draw, and may be drawn into the same tie with another team from the same association.

For the third stage, the eight winners of the second stage were allocated without any draw into the following four ties (G1–G4), with the team in each tie with the higher CONMEBOL ranking hosting the second leg.

*Second stage winner C1 vs. Second stage winner C8
*Second stage winner C2 vs. Second stage winner C7
*Second stage winner C3 vs. Second stage winner C6
*Second stage winner C4 vs. Second stage winner C5<section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the qualifying stages, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] is not played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] is used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.3).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Format />

==Bracket==
<section begin=Bracket />
The qualifying stages are structured as follows:
*'''First stage (6 teams):''' The three winners of the first stage advance to the second stage to join the 13 teams which are given byes to the second stage.
*'''Second stage (16 teams):''' The eight winners of the second stage advance to the third stage.
*'''Third stage (8 teams):''' The four winners of the third stage advance to the group stage to join the 28 direct entrants. The four teams eliminated in the third stage enter the Copa Sudamericana group stage.<section end=Bracket />
The bracket was decided based on the first stage draw and second stage draw, which was held on 20 December 2021.
